news.headline: Intuit Reports Fiscal Q1 2027 Results and Updates Full-Year Guidance
news.summary: Intuit reported fiscal first-quarter earnings that exceeded analyst expectations while simultaneously lowering its revenue outlook for the full 2027 fiscal year.

news.headline: Intuit Enters Agreement to Sell Mailchimp to Bending Spoons
news.summary: Intuit has entered into a definitive agreement to sell its Mailchimp business to Bending Spoons for $3.68 billion.

news.headline: Citigroup Adjusts Price Target on Procter & Gamble
news.summary: Citigroup has increased its price target for The Procter & Gamble Company from $187 to $190.

news.headline: Procter & Gamble Plans to Cut Manufacturing and Logistics Workforce by 20% to 30%
news.summary: Procter & Gamble announced plans to reduce its product-supply workforce by 20% to 30% by 2030 as part of a broader automation and productivity initiative.

news.headline: Analysts Update Price Targets for Procter & Gamble
news.summary: Financial analysts from Wells Fargo and RBC have adjusted their price targets for The Procter & Gamble Company following recent market assessments.
